card: Pin a baseline: Lab forecast compares against your pinned tuning + builds
guards: forecast.test.ts 3 existing cases (card case 1: no baseline = today's result, sameAsCurrent kept, Current reproduces census seeds 40000-40049 per fight hash, 0.25 candidate total = seedsPerWave*4 + labDuels) - green before and after, unchanged
replay goldens and VR parity vectors untouched; core forecast.ts untouched
deviations_from_card: 1) Two feat(combat-lab) commits (plumbing+core tuningDiff+lab-compare with their tests; lab-ui wiring), each green, rather than a separate red test commit. 2) Critic fold-in: core tuningDiff(base, candidate) -> TuningChange[] {key,label,unit,group,from,to} in tuningFields order, spell overrides as spells.<id> with null for absent (APT B cases 1-3 in new packages/core/src/arena/tuning.test.ts). sameTuning/isCurrentTuning not touched (forecast.ts left alone per critic). 3) The baseline lab's own difficulty paces the baseline census (the pin is a full snapshot). 4) A candidate equal to any cached baseline reuses that memo; candidates are still never cached themselves. 5) No new hotkey (operator: hotkeys must not change) - buttons only. Tuning-page Export JSON / Import JSON buttons narrowed and relabelled Export / Import (ids lab-export / lab-import kept) to fit Pin (id lab-pin); builds page gains lab-builds-pin. 6) lab-forecast-view.ts not edited: lab-ui passes compare.baselineName ('Current' or 'pinned <name>') to forecastHeading/forecastLines, and appends lab-compare's duelDeltaText to buildsForecastLine's text when pinned. 7) Changed-knobs readout is one line (first knob + '+n more') at the panel foot, read against the pin or Current.
notes: ForecastRequest.baseline?: {tuning, lab}; ForecastRunner memo maps keyed by field-order tuning key ('' = Current, census path untouched) + difficulty / lab. ForecastClient.want(t, lab, pin?) folds the pin into the key and only adds request.baseline when pinned. LabCompare (lab-compare.ts) validates via validateTuning + validateLabConfig(labConfigOf(setup)) and returns the reason on refusal, keeping the old pin. Gate: 100 files / 798 vitest + node tests + check:design 0 contradictions, first run green. No tuning value changed.
